title: Coordinate difference operator
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $n$ be a natural number, let $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$. The coordinate difference operator at $i$ sends $f$ to the function $x\mapsto f(x)-P_{-i}f(x)$, where $P_{-i}f$ is the average of $f$ over the product distribution with all coordinates other than $i$ fixed at their values in $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
